meta.name: linkerd-patterns
meta.description: Implement Linkerd service mesh patterns for lightweight, security-focused service mesh deployments. Use when setting up Linkerd, configuring traffic policies, or implementing zero-trust networking with minimal overhead.

copy.tagline: 搭建轻量服务网格,实现零信任通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是负责微服务基础设施、需要低开销安全通信的开发者
copy.tagline_en: Deploy a lightweight service mesh for zero-trust communication
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage microservices and need lightweight, secure service-to-service communication

howto.what: 帮你生成 Linkerd 服务网格的配置和命令：安装与校验、命名空间注入、ServiceProfile 的重试与超时、TrafficSplit 灰度、Server 授权策略等，也能给出排障命令。
howto.when: 当你设置 Linkerd、配置流量策略，或想以较低开销实现零信任网络时会触发。

say.text: 帮我在集群里装好 Linkerd 并验证
say.note: 会给出 install 与 linkerd check 命令

say.text: 给 my-service 写一个带重试预算和超时的 ServiceProfile
say.note: 产出按路由的重试、超时 YAML

say.text: 把这个服务的 10% 流量切到 canary 版本
say.note: 生成带权重的 TrafficSplit 配置

howto.what_en: Generates Linkerd service mesh YAML and commands: install and checks, namespace injection, ServiceProfile retries and timeouts, TrafficSplit canaries, Server authorization, plus debug commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you set up Linkerd, configure traffic policies, or implement zero-trust networking with minimal overhead.

say_en.text: Install Linkerd on my cluster and verify it
say_en.note: Returns install and linkerd check commands.

say_en.text: Write a ServiceProfile for my-service with retry budget and timeouts
say_en.note: Produces per-route retry and timeout YAML.

say_en.text: Shift 10% of traffic to the canary version
